prompts.band:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: print-ready flat Canton Guangcai ceramic decal albedo, replacement saucer band. Image 1 is the PRIMARY new China cup product reference. Image 2 is the old master: its artwork is too pale pink and its floral composition too fragmented in the installed narrow crop. Reconstruct a NEW flat strip much closer to Image 1: bright saturated vermilion and carmine/red peony blossoms, rich sunny yellow/ochre ground, yellow-green and emerald dense foliage with fine black-green veins; white/ivory butterfly with black and red markings, small yellow-green Chinese birds with blue feather accents, tiny blue flowers. Large red flowers alternating with birds/butterflies and chrysanthemum details, restrained pale pink. Match the reference's hand-painted Chinese enamel language and extremely fine thin outlines, vivid flat colors, overlapping cropped leaves, intricate petals. This is ONLY a 2D paint texture, not the cup nor a render.
Technical composition: landscape canvas 3072 x 1024, the printable RIBBON occupies exactly the central 30 percent of canvas height from y=35% to 65%, spanning the FULL WIDTH. Compose 7 to 9 mixed flower/bird/butterfly groups across this ribbon, main red blooms approximately the full RIBBON height with some petals clipped by its edges; dense interlocking foliage. Outside the central ribbon plain uniform ochre working space. Central ribbon fully filled top to bottom, no empty horizontal edge, no border. Left/right ribbon ends continue seamlessly, no distinct seam. All ground perfectly uniform ochre #B3924F for later segmentation. No lighting, specular shine, shadows, photographic texture, embossing, gradients in the ground, cup, saucer, metallic simulation, perspective, text, logos, watermark. Output only the one flat master.
prompts.body: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: portrait flat Guangcai enamel print master for the fixed vertical strip and handle. Image 1 is the PRIMARY product reference. Image 2 is the previous master, whose pale pink/white-dominated flowers and muted foliage should be replaced by the richer reference palette and denser composition. Create a new portrait 1024 x 2048 full-bleed master: carmine/vermilion/red peonies dominate, rich yellow ochre ground, vivid emerald and yellow-green veined leaves, golden yellow red-tipped chrysanthemum, ivory butterfly with precise red-black markings, small yellow-green Chinese bird with blue wings and occasional tiny blue flowers and fruit. Substantial vivid RED blooms every few clusters, finely outlined overlapping petals. Keep delicate traditional Canton enamel botanical linework. Dense edge-to-edge overlapping flowers and leaves, ~15% small gaps of perfectly uniform ochre #B3924F. Make the whole pattern coherent, and especially keep the center vertical 16% full of colorful red blooms, leaves and miniature wing details for a narrow handle crop. Opposite edges tile continuously. No large white/pale-pink dominated zones. FLAT 2D albedo scan only, no cup, saucer, perspective, lighting, highlights, shadows, embossing, metallic effects, paper texture, gradients on the ground, borders, text, watermark.
